name: Toronto
source:
“Striving to live a clean life is all well and good,
but know your place.”

Unit: Offense Black, 3rd Squad
Rank: Address

A squad leader who is currently missing.
Formerly a prosecutor, he values justice above all else.

He prefers blunt, unvarnished speech and carries himself in an overbearing manner.
With an unshakably steady mind, his mission success rate is exceptionally high.
